what: A night-sky-like, high-contrast stage-color curtain covers the screen and the center logo sharpens from blur·sepia (opacity .7s · blur 1s). At 1.5s the curtain, cut into a large circle at the bottom, sinks that circle’s center to below the screen (280%) over 2.3s cubic-bezier(.33,.06,.17,.98) — lifting away in a round arc starting from the top of the screen. fx:open fires when lifting starts, fx:done when it is fully lifted

options.[data-fx-part=logo]: (If present) logo at the curtain center — resolves from blur and sepia
options.hold: Time the curtain starts lifting (s), default 1.5 — shorten for screens opened often
options.ease: Curve (like 0.33,0.06,0.17,0.98), default is the original value
options.from · to: Vertical start and end positions from the circle center, default 100% · 280% — on phones use from: 60% (original mobile)
options.lock: if true, locks document scroll until it lifts

note: Instead of a logo on the veil, the original header logo forms at 1.7x at screen center (translateY 23vh), then flies to the header position in 1.8s (.3s delay) on the same curve — that flight lives in the site code (index.css .opening-active). Whoever uses fx:open just removes the class from their own logo.

from.where: index.html .opening (night sky curtain — the header logo stands in for the logo, on phones the logo inside the curtain · from 60%)
